senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; פתן, cmp. פתל , to wind) asp, adder.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19</cite> <he>אפי׳ נְשׁוּךְ פ׳ ועקרב וכ׳</he> even he who was bitten by an asp or a scorpion, &c. (was cured when looking at the brazen serpent); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 764:19">Yalk. ib. 764</cite>; Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 19 <he>נשוך מפ׳ וכ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 323:11">Sifré Deut. 323</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:33">Deut. XXXII, 33</cite>) [read:] <he>אלו הראשונים שבכם שהם כפ׳ הזה אכזרי</he> that means the foremost among you who are like the asp, the cruel; Yalk. ib. 946; a. e.—Pl. <he>פְּתָנִים</he>.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 14:5">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XIV</cite> <he>מרורת פ׳ ומות וכ׳</he> the venom of asps and death are in its (the serpent’s) mouth; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 27:2">Yalk. Gen. 27</cite>.
